messages:
Maria F: FYI — Azure marketplace invoice ChannelReseller_2026-02.pdf looks like it double-counted seats for account ACCT-998. Invoice total up ~$14,320 higher than expected. Attaching invoice and our usage export. Can Partnerships and Accounting confirm mapping? :warning:

Alex P: Can you paste the invoice ID and line items? Is this via Channel Reseller (marketplace) or an Azure reserved billing? I'll loop in Sophia from Channel partners.

Maria F: Invoice ID: 2026-AZ-45321. Attached excerpt:

```
Line 12 | ACCT-998 | SKU: REDW-DYN | Qty: 20 | Unit $356 | Line total $7,120
Line 13 | ACCT-998 | SKU: REDW-DYN | Qty: 20 | Unit $7,120 | Line total $7,120
```

Looks like same SKU repeated.

Ben K: Oof. If that's true this needs a credit vs ChannelReseller. Can you also attach the usage CSV for Feb+Mar? I need GL mapping, salesforce opp id, and the partner invoice PDF. We can do a provisional contra-credit but need VP sign-off. Also: what's the partner settlement window? Azure might not allow retro adjustments beyond 60 days.

Sophia L: Paging @ChannelReseller rep — did you change mappings? We rolled out a pricing band tweak (enterprise -> mid-market) for ACCT-998 on 2026-02-10 but that shouldn't create duplicate lines. Also check if PO 4419 was re-submitted.

Kevin B: To validate locally you can filter invoice json with:
```
cat channelreseller_invoice_2026-02.json | jq '.lineItems[] | select(.account=="ACCT-998")'
```
I ran it against the export Maria uploaded and got two identical entries (same lineId, different sequence). Seems like ingestion bug on partner side.

Maria F: Azure case opened: AZ-9876, assigned to contact: Noor from Azure. ChannelReseller case: CR-8893. SF case: SF-78910 linked to the customer.

Ben K: I'm ok to approve a provisional customer-facing credit up to $15,000 to prevent revenue leakage while we sort ledger entries. @Rita V can you sign-off? We'll need the writeup for audit: invoice PDF, usage export, partner confirmation, and the proposed credit memo amount.

Rita V: OK provisional credit approved up to $15k. Please add me to CR-8893 and AZ-9876. Finance needs a 1-pager describing cause, timeline, and reconciliation plan. We'll hard-approve only after partner provides corrected invoice or Azure issues adjustment.

Sophia L: I'll chase ChannelReseller and request corrected invoice by EOD tomorrow. If they push back, we'll escalate to partner SLA team. Tagging partner ops: @alex.p and @kevin.b

Alex P: noted. Next steps: 1) Sophia to get corrected invoice; 2) Ben to prepare provisional credit memo; 3) Maria to update SF & Azure cases; 4) Kevin to drop filtered evidence in the finance folder. ETA 48 hours.

azure-billing-bot: Ticket AZ-9876 status -> In investigation. Contact: Noor Ali (noor.ali@azure.com). Last update: partner-side ingestion flagged as possible duplicate line creation.

Maria F: Thanks all. I'll drop the CSV + jq output into s3://redwood-finance/partners/channelreseller/ACCT-998/ and update SF. :thumbsup:

Ben K: I'll prep the provisional memo and upload under /finance/credit-memos/provisional/CR-8893-provisional.pdf

Rita V: Once uploaded mention me here. Good catch.
